glossary.definition:
(A) "Adopted person" means a person who, as a minor, was adopted and who, on or after September 18, 1996, became available or potentially available for adoption. For the purpose of this division, a person was available or potentially available for adoption on or after September 18, 1996, if, on or after that date, either of the following occurred:

(1) At least one of the person's birth parents executed consent to the person's adoption.

(2) A probate court entered a finding that the consent of at least one of the person's birth parents to the person's adoption was not needed as determined pursuant to section 3107.07 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Adoption file" means the file maintained by the department of health under sections 3705.12 to 3705.124 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Adoptive parent" means a person who adopted an adopted person.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Authorization of release form" means the form prescribed under division (A)(2) of section 3107.50 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Birth parent" means the biological parent of an adopted person.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Birth sibling" means a biological sibling of an adopted person.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition:
(G) "Denial of release form" means either of the following:

(1) The component of the form prescribed under division (A)(1)(b) of section 3107.083 if the birth parent checked the "no" space provided on that component.

(2) The form prescribed under division (A)(1) of section 3107.50 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Effective denial of release form" means a denial of release form that has not been rescinded by an authorization of release form pursuant to division (B) of section 3107.46 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Final decree of adoption" includes an interlocutory order of adoption that has become final.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Identifying information" has the same meaning as in section 3107.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Items of identification" include a motor vehicle driver's or commercial driver's license, an identification card issued under sections 4507.50 to 4507.52 of the Revised Code, a marriage application, a social security card, a credit card, a military identification card, or an employee identification card.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3107.45 to 3107.53 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3107.45 - Access to adoption records additional definitions.
